_: Nazaré from the start: from the fort by the lighthouse, a long winter swell from the west-north-west bending in over the shelf; its set stacks off Praia do Norte and the camera drops to the channel to see the wave stand, then climbs back. Then swipes send swells in: a long one (its set stacking again), a short one (crossing the canyon, nothing stacks), a long one from the north-west.
